evidence.detail: rs/cache/b owns one shared data RandomAccessFile, an array of exactly five index RandomAccessFiles, and an array of exactly five R25 Decompressor instances.

Its initializer opens one named data file and five index files using a shared index-prefix plus indices 0..4, then constructs Decompressor stores with store ids 1..5 over the shared data file and corresponding index file.

R24 OnDemandFetcher owns four rs/cache/b instances and initializes them against main_file_cache.dat/main_file_cache.idx and main_file_osrs.dat/main_file_osrs.idx variants, then consumers index directly into the returned Decompressor[] stores.
The only public getter returns the five-element Decompressor[] array, confirming this object is a grouped cache-store set rather than an individual store or update fetcher.

proposals.note: CacheStoreSet is a conservative semantic recovery name for this grouped five-Decompressor cache-file wrapper; it deliberately avoids conflating the class with R24 OnDemandFetcher.
